text_preview: UML Component Diagram
Suicide-Risk Detection Using NLP-Based Text and Speech Analysis — Final Corrected Architecture
> User Interface Text Input | Speech Input | Both
> Text Processing Component Whitespace Cleaning Tokenization / Model-specific Representation

> Text Classification Model Baseline: BiLSTM / Frozen BERT / TF-IDF SVM SDCNL Label Correction: BERT → UMAP → GMM (τ=0.90) Primary Fast Model: Word+Char TF-IDF + Calibrated LinearSVC 85.75% label-corrected accuracy
Text Risk Score P_text (0–1)
> Speech Processing Component Prefer *_out.wav → Raw fallback if needed Mono 16 kHz + Peak Normalization MFCC, Pitch, RMS, ZCR, Spectral Centroid, Duration
> Speech Classification Model Single-audio acoustic features Logistic Regression Participant-grouped CV EATD validation accuracy: 63.29%

Layers, model artifacts and information movement
INPUT LAYER Text • Speech • Both
PREPROCESSING LAYER Text normalization / tokenization Audio selection / 16kHz normalization
FEATURE / REPRESENTATION LAYER TF-IDF / embeddings MFCC • Pitch • RMS • ZCR • Spectral
MODEL LAYER Text classifier Speech distress classifier
MODEL ARTIFACTS Vectorizer / Vocabulary Scaler / Saved Models
